l4_steps.name: Activate DCS flight check-in window
l4_steps.input: Flight schedule activation trigger from PSS; T-24h threshold reached
l4_steps.output: Check-in window open; flight record active in DCS with configured limits
l4_steps.kpi: Check-in window live within 2 min of scheduled T-24h open time
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa DCS activation can lag if PSS flight record contains schedule irregularity codes from prior disruption; agents must manually resolve before window opens

l4_steps.name: Transmit APIS data to government gateway
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa DCS + SITA APIS Gateway
l4_steps.input: Passenger PNR records with passport/travel document data collected at booking
l4_steps.output: APIS message transmitted to CBP (US) or destination country border authority
l4_steps.kpi: APIS transmission ≥99.5% success rate; all records sent ≥60 min pre-departure
l4_steps.pain_point: Incomplete passport data in PNR (collected via NDC or OTA) prevents automated APIS; agents must manually collect at counter, increasing queue time by avg 4 min/pax

l4_steps.name: Validate APIS clearance response from authority
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa DCS + SITA APIS Gateway
l4_steps.input: Government APIS response message (OK / Inhibit / Further Check)
l4_steps.output: Passenger flagged as cleared or held; DCS boarding permission set accordingly
l4_steps.kpi: APIS clearance rate ≥99.8%; inhibit rate <0.2% on domestic sectors
l4_steps.pain_point: CBP Inhibit responses arrive without explanation; agents must contact CBP Passenger Analysis Unit directly, causing delays of 15–45 min with no SLA guarantee

l4_steps.name: Process web/mobile self-service check-in
l4_steps.input: Passenger booking reference or e-ticket number; opens T-24h pre-departure
l4_steps.output: Mobile or PDF boarding pass issued; seat confirmed (where applicable)
l4_steps.kpi: Web/mobile check-in adoption ≥65% of pax; avg session completion <3 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa Web Check-In has limited SSR (special service request) handling — passengers requiring wheelchair, UMNR, or PETC must complete check-in at counter, reducing self-service deflection rate

l4_steps.name: Process airport kiosk check-in
l4_steps.system: SITA CUSS Kiosk + Amadeus Altéa DCS
l4_steps.input: Booking reference, e-ticket barcode scan, or passport MRZ scan
l4_steps.output: Boarding pass printed at kiosk; baggage tag receipt if bags declared
l4_steps.kpi: Kiosk transaction time ≤90 sec avg; kiosk availability ≥98.5% uptime
l4_steps.pain_point: CUSS kiosk MRZ readers degrade in high-throughput environments; passport scan failure rate >5% triggers agent-assisted queue diversion, negating kiosk capacity benefit

l4_steps.name: Counter check-in for SSR & irregular pax
l4_steps.input: Passenger queue; SSR flags (WCHR, UMNR, PETC, excess baggage, name discrepancy)
l4_steps.output: Check-in complete with SSR coded; boarding pass issued; special handling instructions added to PNR
l4_steps.kpi: Counter transaction time ≤4 min/pax; SSR coding accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa DCS SSR codes not always consumed by downstream ramp/catering systems in real time; WCHR requests can fail to appear on OCS load sheet if coded after T-45 min

l4_steps.name: Verify travel documents & eligibility to travel
l4_steps.input: Passenger passport, visa, travel document; destination entry requirements from Timatic
l4_steps.output: Document check passed or failed; boarding authorization set in DCS
l4_steps.kpi: Document check failure rate <0.5%; inadmissible pax rate <0.1% of international sector pax
l4_steps.pain_point: Timatic database lags behind real-time government policy changes (e.g., COVID-era entry requirements updated faster than Timatic refresh); airlines face deportation liability and repatriation costs averaging $3,000–$5,000 per inadmissible passenger

l4_steps.name: Issue boarding pass and confirm check-in
l4_steps.input: Completed check-in record; APIS cleared; seat assigned
l4_steps.output: Boarding pass (mobile wallet, PDF, or thermal print) with barcode; PNR status updated to HK
l4_steps.kpi: Boarding pass issuance within 30 sec of check-in completion; barcode scan success rate ≥99.9% at gate
l4_steps.pain_point: Mobile boarding pass wallet integration (Apple Wallet / Google Wallet) requires Altéa connector; third-party OTA bookings may not receive push update if itinerary changed post-check-in, causing boarding pass mismatch at gate

l4_steps.name: Accept, weigh & measure checked baggage
l4_steps.input: Passenger with checked bags at counter or self-service bag drop; ticket with baggage allowance
l4_steps.output: Bag weight/dimensions recorded in DCS; excess baggage fee calculated if applicable
l4_steps.kpi: Baggage acceptance transaction ≤90 sec; excess bag fee collection accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: SITA BagDrop scale calibration drift causes weight discrepancies; bags near allowance threshold require re-weighing at counter, increasing queue time and creating customer disputes

l4_steps.name: Print & apply IATA 10-digit baggage tag
l4_steps.input: Accepted bag; passenger PNR with flight and destination data
l4_steps.output: IATA 10-digit bag tag printed and applied; bag record created in WorldTracer
l4_steps.kpi: Bag tag print success rate ≥99.8%; bag tag scan read rate at sortation ≥99.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa bag tag thermal print quality degrades in high-humidity airport environments; low-contrast tags fail sortation OCR/barcode readers, causing misrouting — IATA Resolution 753 tracking mandates every bag event be captured

l4_steps.name: Induct bags into EDS/TSA screening belt
l4_steps.system: Airport EDS System (TSA-operated) + SITA Baggage Reconciliation System
l4_steps.input: Tagged, accepted bags inducted at sortation entry point
l4_steps.output: Bag inducted into automated screening belt; bag status updated to 'In Screening'
l4_steps.kpi: Bag induction-to-screening time ≤15 min; EDS throughput ≥1,200 bags/hr per lane
l4_steps.pain_point: TSA EDS systems are airport authority / TSA-owned, not airline-controlled; EDS lane outages cause cascading bag delays with no airline SLA recourse — peak holiday periods see queue back-ups exceeding 45 min

l4_steps.name: Resolve EDS alarm — security secondary screening
l4_steps.role: TSA Security Officer / Baggage Services Agent
l4_steps.system: Airport EDS System + SITA Baggage Reconciliation System
l4_steps.input: EDS alarm triggered on specific bag; bag diverted to manual inspection lane
l4_steps.output: Bag cleared after manual inspection or removed from flight; BRS status updated
l4_steps.kpi: Secondary screening resolution time ≤20 min pre-departure; cleared bags ≥95% make flight
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual EDS secondary screening has no airline-controlled SLA; if passenger has already boarded, policy requires offloading all bags and re-matching — per TSA requirement — causing departure delay averaging 22 min

l4_steps.name: Open gate & configure boarding group sequence
l4_steps.system: SITA Airport Management System (AMS) + Amadeus Altéa DCS
l4_steps.input: DCS flight record with check-in close count; gate assignment from AMS
l4_steps.output: Gate screen displays boarding groups; boarding group logic configured in DCS
l4_steps.kpi: Gate open ≥35 min pre-departure; boarding group display accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate assignments change frequently due to aircraft swaps; SITA AMS gate change notification can lag DCS by 3–5 min, causing agents to set up at wrong gate — high at congested hubs like ATL and ORD

l4_steps.name: Assess oversale position & solicit volunteers
l4_steps.input: Check-in close count vs. aircraft capacity; upgrade waitlist; standby list
l4_steps.output: Oversale position confirmed; VDB (voluntary denied boarding) offer issued if overbooked
l4_steps.kpi: VDB offer initiated ≥25 min pre-departure; IDB (involuntary) rate <0.05 per 10,000 boarded (DOT threshold)
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa DCS overbooking display does not auto-factor no-show passengers from connecting flights until T-15 min; late confirmation of actual seat count means VDB offers are solicited unnecessarily or too late for proper compensation negotiation

l4_steps.name: Process VDB compensation & rebook denied pax
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa DCS + Airline Voucher System
l4_steps.input: Volunteer passenger confirmed for VDB; compensation amount per DOT 14 CFR Part 250
l4_steps.output: VDB compensation issued (cash/voucher/miles); pax rebooked on next available service
l4_steps.kpi: VDB compensation processing time ≤8 min; rebooking on same-day flight ≥85% of VDB cases
l4_steps.pain_point: Voucher issuance system integration with Altéa DCS is not real-time at all stations; agents at outstations must use paper vouchers subject to fraud risk and delayed reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA AR

l4_steps.name: Scan boarding passes & verify pax identity
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa DCS + SITA Gate Reader
l4_steps.input: Passenger presenting boarding pass (mobile/paper) at gate scanner
l4_steps.output: Boarding pass scanned; pax status updated to 'Boarded' in DCS; seat confirmed
l4_steps.kpi: Gate scan throughput ≥30 pax/min; scan success rate ≥99.5%; first scan read rate ≥99%
l4_steps.pain_point: Mobile boarding pass screen brightness and barcode display inconsistency (especially on cracked screens) causes scan failures; SITA gate reader firmware version mismatches with Altéa DCS on shared CUTE gates cause intermittent rejections during irregular ops re-accommodation

l4_steps.name: Perform final headcount & manifest reconciliation
l4_steps.input: Boarding complete; gate close signal; boarded pax count from DCS
l4_steps.output: Final passenger manifest reconciled; pax count confirmed against physical headcount
l4_steps.kpi: Manifest accuracy 100% (regulatory — FAR 121.693); reconciliation completed ≥5 min pre-departure
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate reader offline events (network drop at remote stands) cause boarding records to queue locally and sync after pushback begins; manifest can show in-transit counts that require captain confirmation, delaying doors-closed by 3–8 min

l4_steps.name: Transmit final load sheet & close flight in DCS
l4_steps.input: Reconciled pax count; final baggage and cargo weights; zero fuel weight from ramp
l4_steps.output: Final load sheet transmitted to cockpit via ACARS; DCS flight status set to Departed
l4_steps.kpi: Load sheet transmitted ≥3 min pre-pushback; captain acceptance acknowledgement received 100% of flights
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS OOOI message timing and load sheet transmission depend on aircraft avionics connectivity; older narrowbody aircraft without VHF ACARS datalink require VHF voice relay, increasing workload for dispatch and introducing manual transcription errors in weight & balance
